verdict.rationale: A government immigration service could plausibly publish a system-to-system channel such as system accounts, transmitter programs or batch-provider enrollment, so the axis applies. The only evidence is a probe that failed TLS verification at aima.gov.pt/robots.txt, and nothing on the host was fetched. There is therefore no evidence of a documented machine channel or a published enrollment path, and absence of evidence for an applicable capability is 'none'.
